signature.name: Nyhavn
signature.detail: The 17th-century harbor with colorful gabled townhouses and wooden ships is Copenhagen's most photographed spot. Visit early morning to avoid crowds, or take a canal boat tour from the quay.

signature.name: Tivoli Gardens
signature.detail: One of the world's oldest amusement parks, offering charming gardens, rides, and evening illuminations. Book tickets online and go after dark for the best atmosphere.

signature.name: The Little Mermaid
signature.detail: The iconic bronze statue inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale sits on a rock by the harbor. It's a short walk from Nyhavn; go early to avoid tour groups.

signature.name: Amalienborg
signature.detail: The royal family's winter residence, featuring four identical palaces around an octagonal square. Watch the changing of the guard at noon (daily) and visit the museum.

signature.name: Rosenborg Castle
signature.detail: A Renaissance castle housing the Danish crown jewels and royal regalia. Buy a combined ticket with the Round Tower and visit on a weekday to avoid queues.

signature.name: Christiansborg Palace
signature.detail: Home to the Danish Parliament and royal reception rooms, with ruins of the original castle in the basement. Climb the tower for free panoramic views of the city.

signature.name: The Round Tower
signature.detail: A 17th-century astronomical observatory with a spiral ramp leading to a rooftop platform. Go at sunset for great photo opportunities; entry is inexpensive.
